title: Colours

location.series: City of Helsinki live visual identity guidelines

slide_intent: Judge color against its background so a viewer can read a moving-image message.
strategic_value: Retaining the city palette while checking legibility can connect Helsinki videos without sacrificing comprehension.
demonstration: This expanded webpage-section capture states that the full city palette is available for video and links to definitions and accessible combinations.
practical_value: Choose a palette color only after checking its pairing and any image behind the text.

content_islands.name: Color permission and condition
content_islands.spec: Keep the all-colors permission with the legibility qualification.

content_islands.name: Reference links
content_islands.spec: Place city definitions and accessible-combination links below the explanation.

reference_purposes.Intent: The text explains accessibility as making text easy enough to read.
reference_purposes.Application: It instructs designers to consider color pairs and background images.
reference_purposes.Constraint: Use of the palette in video is conditional on accessible reading.
